Deliberately built as SHAPE DISCOVERY, not a contract proof: the image and its env are verified from primary sources (glpi/glpi is HTTP 200 on Docker Hub with 11.0.8 a real tag; glpiproject/glpi is a 404 and unused; GLPI_DB_* and the MariaDB backend come from the image's own published description), but the REST surface is NOT — GLPI ships a v1 /apirest.php and a v2 whose shape differs by release, and nothing here has driven either. That ordering is the lesson from the headwind lane, where a credential was asserted instead of observed and turned out never to have authenticated anywhere.
